summary: T. Rowe Price OHA Select Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, declaring regular monthly distributions of $0.2000 per share across all share classes, payable May 29, 2026 to holders of record April 30, 2026. The filing also disclosed March 31, 2026 NAV of $26.15 per share, aggregate NAV of $1,638.4 million, portfolio fair value of $2,983.7 million, and debt of $1,468.6 million (0.90x debt/equity). Additionally, the company updated its continuous public offering of up to $2.5 billion in shares. The filing is a routine disclosure of distributions, NAV, and offering status, not a special situation.
